services.title: Our services
services.intro: Passenger transport for the corporate and institutional world. Every service is coordinated directly and adapted to your operation.

items.title: Staff transport
items.text: Daily or shift-based transport for your company's teams, with tailored routes and schedules.

items.title: Executive transfers
items.text: Premium service for executives and visitors: punctuality, discretion and comfort.

items.title: Event services
items.text: Transport logistics for seminars, celebrations and corporate events.

items.title: Airport transfers
items.text: Punctual transfers to and from Carriel Sur airport, coordinated with your flight.

items.title: Institutional tours & activities
items.text: Transport for schools, universities and institutions on tours and activities.

items.title: Special services
items.text: Something different? We design the service around your needs.

services.bottomCtaTitle: Can't find what you're looking for?

agreement.title: Corporate agreements
agreement.intro: The WinTransfer corporate agreement gives your company reliable transport with preferential conditions and direct coordination, no intermediaries.
agreement.whatText: It's a standing service agreement between your organization and WinTransfer: your team requests transfers whenever needed and we respond with priority, preferential rates and formal invoicing.

process.title: Agreement signing
process.text: We formalize the agreement with your organization.

process.title: Service request
process.text: You request transfers through the agreed channel, whenever you need.

process.title: Availability confirmation
process.text: We confirm vehicle, schedule and conditions.

process.title: Transfer execution
process.text: We deliver the service safely and on time.
